name: PHRX 5176
title: Professional Experience in Population Health II
description: The goal of this APPE is to immerse the student to patient care in the population health setting. Through their participation, students will gain the knowledge, skills, and attitudes necessary to provide patient care to patients with similar characteristics. Students will gain experience in understanding interventions based on population health initiatives.
requirement_description: PHRX 5065; open only to students in the School of Pharmacy.
